## Activity

During November 2022, North City Eye Clinic recorded 468 captures. This level of activity provides the basis for the month’s image-quality and grading review. Capture activity should continue to be monitored through routine site reporting, with any operational matters recorded promptly so that they can be considered alongside the results.

## Image quality

Of the 468 captures, 12 were marked ungradable, giving an ungradable rate of 2.6. This represents the proportion of images that could not be assessed for grading purposes. The clinic lead has asked that recurring camera issues be logged with the service desk to support follow-up and reduce avoidable image-quality problems.

## Grading

Grading identified 115 referable results during November 2022. These results should be managed in accordance with the relevant clinical pathway and local operational arrangements. The median lag from photograph capture to completion of grading was 2 days. Monitoring the grading lag alongside referable findings will help the service identify any emerging delays and maintain timely handling of results.
